nodes.label: ops.start
nodes.desc: apisix start: validates env, renders nginx.conf and execs OpenResty (L178, L1087).

nodes.label: http_init_worker
nodes.desc: Worker bootstrap: events, lrucache, timers, balancer, admin, config core, plugins, router (L120, L143-L172).

nodes.label: http_access_phase
nodes.desc: Per-request entry: api_ctx from tablepool, route match, service merge, plugin runs (L915, L924, L991, L1037, L1105).

nodes.label: common_phase
nodes.desc: Shared hook runner: global rules plus per-phase plugin execution (L664, L678).

nodes.label: handle_upstream
nodes.desc: Resolves upstream id or inline conf, sets upstream, picks a server, runs before_proxy (L716, L781, L787, L798).

nodes.label: http_balancer_phase
nodes.desc: balancer run stage used for proxy retries after failures (L1662, L1669).

nodes.label: http_header_filter_phase
nodes.desc: Response header stage for plugin hooks (L1431).

nodes.label: http_body_filter_phase
nodes.desc: Response body stage for plugin hooks (L1473).

nodes.label: http_log_phase
nodes.desc: Log stage: passive health checks, after_balance reporting, api_ctx returned to the pool (L1620, L1631, L1658).

nodes.label: router.lua
nodes.desc: Loads the configured router module (radixtree_uri default) and attaches shared match methods (L81, L87, L91).

nodes.label: radixtree_uri
nodes.desc: URI router: builds a radixtree from routes and matches URI/host/vars (L30, L51).

nodes.label: radixtree_host_uri
nodes.desc: Host+URI router selected by config.apisix.router.http (L145).

nodes.label: api_router
nodes.desc: Internal Control API endpoints served from workers (L100).

nodes.label: plugin.load
nodes.desc: Reads the enabled plugin list from local conf and requires each module (L420).

nodes.label: sort_plugin
nodes.desc: Sorts plugins by descending priority so higher values run first (L142).

nodes.label: merge_service_route
nodes.desc: Merges service-level plugin conf into the route (also consumer route merge, L763, L871).

nodes.label: plugin.filter
nodes.desc: Builds the per-request plugin list from route, service and consumer conf (L575).

nodes.label: run_plugin
nodes.desc: Executes the phase hook of each plugin in priority order (L1362).

nodes.label: key-auth
nodes.desc: Consumer authentication by API key header; priority 2500, rewrite phase (L55, L110).

nodes.label: proxy-rewrite
nodes.desc: Rewrites upstream URI, headers and host; priority 1008, rewrite phase (L175, L309).

nodes.label: limit-req
nodes.desc: Leaky-bucket request shaping keyed by rate and burst; priority 1001, access phase (L93, L138).

nodes.label: ai-proxy
nodes.desc: Proxies to LLM providers through a unified config; priority 1040, access phase (L29, L56).

nodes.label: ai-rate-limiting
nodes.desc: Token-based windows for AI traffic; priority 1030, access phase (L176, L295).

nodes.label: prometheus
nodes.desc: Exports metrics; priority 500 with its own /prometheus metrics endpoint (L81, L105).

nodes.label: upstream.set_by_route
nodes.desc: Normalizes nodes, scheme, keepalive and TLS for the matched route (L381).

nodes.label: pick_server
nodes.desc: Health-aware picker: eligible nodes, warm-up, retries; loads balancer module by type (L151, L154, L275, L501).

nodes.label: roundrobin
nodes.desc: Weighted round-robin picker (L27).

nodes.label: least_conn
nodes.desc: Least in-flight connections picker (L115).

nodes.label: core.lua
nodes.desc: Core toolkit; picks the config provider (etcd default, yaml/json standalone) (L24, L34).

nodes.label: config_etcd
nodes.desc: etcd watcher: sync_data poll loop per key prefix, new() store, init_worker timer (L722, L1053, L1256).

nodes.label: config_yaml
nodes.desc: Standalone store: sync_data reads apisix.yaml, _automatic_fetch timer hot-reloads (L245, L421, L554).

nodes.label: admin.run
nodes.desc: Admin REST dispatcher: check_token then resource[method] handler per URI segment (L82, L176, L254).

nodes.label: admin/resource
nodes.desc: Generic resource CRUD: get, put, post, delete, patch (L149, L260, L339).

nodes.label: admin/routes
nodes.desc: Route resource: schema check, upstream/service refs, vars expression (L54, L183).
